$comment: The capabilities a node can offer: the single source of their names (issue #206, docs/PROTOCOL.md "Capability names"). roles = the node roles whose default config switches the capability on; an empty list means an admin adds it to config.capabilities by hand. The input schema of each capability is the one the node reports in inventory.capabilities[].input_schema. Adding a capability: one entry here, the code on the node, and its text in web/src/i18n/en.json and de.json (tools.cap.<prefix>.<action>, from the name, not from group).
